name: Milchis Catalin-Marian
headline: Working across cybersecurity and telecom
bio: I'm a 4th-year Telecommunications student at Transilvania University of Brasov. I work part-time on web and API security assessments at Arvato Systems Romania and in telecom R&D at Mitel Networks Romania. I am a member of the Brasov Cybersecurity Community, represent UNITBV in CTF competitions and mentor high-school students in mechatronics. In my spare time I explore wireless and RF security, software-defined radio and hardware hacking.

education.faculty: Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
extracurriculars: InfoTRON 2026 mentor: six weeks of mechatronics workshops (ESP32) for two high-school groups in Brasov
